name.description: Target teammate name (lowercase Latin letters, digits and accents such as á é í ó ú ü ñ, optional -N suffix); use the names listed in the <peers> element of the <swarm> context.

message.description: Plain-text message body delivered to the target session.

reply_to.description: Exact opaque ID of a message you received; quote it verbatim when answering that message.

wait_for_reply.description: Block until the first correlated reply arrives or the wait times out. Only set it when the next action depends on the answer.
